pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth to slightly blurred edge gradients. Spatial area is significantly larger on the upper flank and dorsal regions, becoming progressively smaller and more fragmented toward the posterior and ventral areas.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light negative space forms a continuous topological lattice. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. The pixel thickness of these pathways remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank region.

other_distinctive_markers: A dark, elongated appendage with a black terminal tuft is draped horizontally across the rump and mid-flank, creating a sharp linear occlusion of the underlying pelage pattern.
